title: Update ephemeral docs for presence rate window and expiry rules
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[wss] Update ephemeral docs for presence rate window and expiry rules
Spec (): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md L298: "events above this rate MAY be silently dropped, but the most recent presence state SHOULD be delivered when the rate window reopens"; L131: "A server that does not close the connection when credentials expire SHOULD NOT deliver further ephemeral events on that connection."; L275: "`\"invisible\"` is not a value of this field. The server reports a contact whose presence is `\"invisible\"` ... as `\"offline\"`."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/ephemeral.rs:16-27; crate-jmap-chat-server/src/ephemeral.rs:142-145; crate-jmap-chat-server/src/ephemeral.rs:197-205
Now: The module docs leave rate limiting to the deployment and quote the old presence text, which has no rule to deliver the latest state. They also quote removed MUST wording ("Servers MUST verify at delivery time", "Servers MUST NOT deliver ChatPresenceEvent", "The \"invisible\" value MUST NOT appear"). Nothing tells transports to stop ephemeral delivery after credential expiry. The behavior itself is already correct.
Change: Docs only: re-quote the current text and tell transport implementers to (a) send the most recent coalesced presence state when the 30 s window reopens and (b) stop ephemeral delivery on a connection whose credentials have expired. No logic change, because the crate has no transport or rate limiter.
